topic: Effects of Sun's Heat and Light
key_concepts: The sun is the main source of heat and light
Sunlight helps plants make their own food
Sunlight supports animal survival and some animals' UV vision
Sun heat and light enable human activities like drying clothes, crops, and fish
UV rays can help skin conditions such as psoriasis
Sunlight stimulates the pineal gland to produce mood-improving tryptamines
UV rays can kill or deactivate microorganisms for disinfection and sterilization
Too much sun exposure can cause sunburn, skin cancer, heat stroke, and visual impairment
Overexposure to sunlight can wilt plants, dry and crack soil, and harm animals
UV overexposure can harm the immune system and cause premature skin aging
Skin cancer types include basal carcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, and melanoma
